251:The Directorate of Education (DOE) at Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU), Jhansi, was established in 2018 in alignment with the provisions of the Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University Act, 2014 (No. 10 of 2014) where in the Directorate of Education is responsible of planning, coordination, and supervision of all educational programmes in the various Faculties of the University. Dedicated to the continuous enhancement of academic quality, the Directorate undertakes key functions such as academic planning, curriculum development, coordination of teaching activities, and the implementation of vision and policies related to agriculture education. It plays a vital role in monitoring the examination and evaluation systems, developing and updating curricula based on emerging trends and needs, and integrating educational technologies. It also focuses on faculty development and human resource management through regular training and capacity-building programmes. It fosters academic collaborations with national and international institutions to promote excellence in education and research. In accordance with the policies of the University and the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), the curricula and syllabi are reviewed and updated periodically. New courses are introduced to address contemporary challenges and opportunities in agriculture and allied sciences. Additionally, special coaching programmes and certificate courses are organized in all constituent colleges to support students in excelling in competitive examinations such as ICAR-NET, JRF, GATE, ARS, and other national-level assessments.

The College of Agriculture, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University is located in the main campus of the University at Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh). The College is providing quality education and training in the field of agriculture and allied sciences. The college is offering U.G., P.G. & Ph.D. degrees in various discipline of Agriculture. Till date 07 UG and 05 PG batches have been passed out. It has 10 departments with required state of art smart classrooms, infrastructural and laboratory facilities. B.Sc. Agriculture (Hons.) in Natural Farming has also started from 2023-24 academic session. To establish College of Agriculture as a knowledge hub for development of quality human resource development & technology using cutting edge science.
Holistic development of human resources through innovations, skill development and entrepreneurship.
Working as an epicenter of agricultural education and research by harnessing the power of cutting-edge science for regenerative agriculture & sustainable development.
Inclusive growth of stakeholders through skill-oriented trainings, digitization of agro-technologies.
The present sanctioned strength of B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture is 100 which will further increase to 120 from the academic session 2025-26. B.Sc. Agriculture (Hons.) in Natural Farming has intake of 20 students. The college is having following 10 Departments i.e. Department of Agronomy, Department of Soil Science, Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, Department of Plant Pathology, Department of Entomology, Department of Basic Sciences, Department of Agricultural Extension & Communications, Department of Agricultural Engineering, Department of Molecular Biology & Biotechnology and Department of Agricultural Economics. The College is offering PG in 10 disciplines i.e. Agronomy, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, Soil Science, Agricultural Extension Education and Agricultural Economics, Seed Science and Technology and Agricultural Engineering and Ph.D. (Ag.) in 6 disciplines i.e. Agronomy, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Soil Science and Agriculture Extension Education.

The College of Horticulture and Forestry, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, is located on the university’s main campus in Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh). Established in 2016, the college aims to deliver high-quality education and training in horticulture and forestry sciences.
Presently, the college has 10 departments with all infrastructural and lab facilities. At the UG level, the college offers B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture and B.Sc. (Hons.) Forestry degree programmes. To date, the college has graduated four batches of B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture and B.Sc. (Hons.) Forestry. In the academic session 2023–24, the sanctioned strength of B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture and B.Sc. (Hons.) Forestry increased to 40 students.
The College offers M.Sc. Horticulture in 4 disciplines, i.e., Fruit Science, Vegetable Science and Floriculture & Landscaping, with an intake of four students in each and Post-harvest Management with an intake of 2 students.
The College offers M. Sc. Forestry in 4 disciplines, i.e., Silviculture & Agro-forestry with an intake of 7 students, Forest Products & Utilization with an intake of 4 students and Forest Resource Management and Forest Biology & Tree Improvement, with an intake of 2 students in each.
The college offers doctoral degree programmes in three disciplines of Horticulture, viz., Fruit Science, Vegetable Science and Floriculture & Landscaping, with an intake of 2 students in each discipline and one discipline in Forestry, viz., Silviculture & Agro-forestry with an intake of 4 students.
The B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture program offers an experiential learning program (ELP) on “Commercial Horticulture” and B.Sc. (Hons.) Forestry program offers two experiential learning program (ELP) on “Raising Quality planting material” and “Processing of MAPs and forest products” to enhance the students’ skill and entrepreneurship development.
The college has successfully implemented three RKVY projects on Hi-tech nursery production in horticulture, Forestry and, protected cultivation of cut-flowers and developed infrastructure like polyhouses, propagation chambers, cold stores, germination chamber etc.
The College of Horticulture and Forestry has a well-developed Horticulture and Forestry research farm and laboratories to cater to the needs of students in UG, PG and doctoral degree programs with quality teaching, research, and practical learning.
The college has a fully air-conditioned academic building with smart class rooms and central research laboratories alongwith geospatial research and technology laboratory for effective delivery of the curriculum. The college is well equipped with farm machinery, a protected structures, a well-developed library, including an e-library, a crop cafeteria of fruits, vegetables, ornamental plants, medicinal and aromatic plants etc.
The College has employed highly qualified and experienced faculty to cater good education to the students and support the college’s research and extension activities. The College of Horticulture and Forestry faculty aims to train students and impart knowledge to develop skilled human resources so that they can contribute in sustainable development of country. The alumni from the College have cleared various competitive exams at the national level and brought laurels to the name of university.
The National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB) of ICAR, New Delhi, accredited the College of Agriculture for a period of 5 years in 2021.

The College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, located in Datia, Madhya Pradesh, is a constituent unit of Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU), Jhansi. The foundation stone of the College was laid on September 27, 2020, and the campus spans approximately 200 acres. The college features a fully air-conditioned academic building equipped with smart classrooms, examination and training halls, museums, state-of-the-art research laboratories, an auditorium, a library with e-library access, a computer laboratory, a central instrumentation facility, conference halls, and administrative offices. The Datia campus is equipped with well-furnished separate hostels for boys and girls with round the clock internet facility along with accommodation facilities for farmers and staff quarters, ensuring a safe, comfortable and conducive environment for students, faculty, and visitors. The campus includes an advanced Livestock Farm Complex, designed to house various species of farm animals, and fodder production to facilitate practical demonstrations, trainings and research in animal husbandry and management. A super-specialty Veterinary Clinical Complex, has been meticulously designed withing the campus to offer advanced diagnosis, treatment, and critical care services for both pet and farm animals while also offering hands-on training and practical exposure to students. Additionally, the campus has indoor and outdoor sports facilities as well as medical facility to ensure the physical fitness and overall development of students and staff.
The college offers an undergraduate program that award Bachelor of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) degree and postgraduate programs that award a Master’s degree (M.V.Sc.) and a Doctoral degree (Ph.D.) in various disciplines of veterinary sciences. The college also conducts certificate courses, frontline demonstrations, training programs, and health camps to enhance skills and knowledge, raise awareness, promote self-employment, and improve animal health and productivity in the Bundelkhand region, where livestock plays a crucial economic role. In addition to its academic programs, the college places a strong emphasis on research and extension activities. Faculty and students actively participate in research projects that address local challenges in animal health and production. Through its extension services, the college disseminates knowledge and technologies to farmers and livestock owners, with the goal of improving livelihoods. The institution strives to achieve excellence in teaching, research, and extension activities in the field of veterinary and animal sciences.

Globally, as well as in India, the fisheries sector has been making significantccontributions to meeting food and nutritional security goals. India currently occupies 2 nd and 3 rd positions in global aquaculture and overall fish production. The states of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh have great potential for fish farming. These states also encompass a geographically and culturally distinct Bundelkhand region. Bundelkhand, with an area of ~69,000 square km, comprises 7 districts (Lalitpur, Jhansi, Jalaun, Hamirpur, Mahoba, Banda, and Chitrakoot) of Uttar Pradesh and 7 districts (Chhatarpur, Tikamgarh, Damoh, Sagar, Datia,Niwari and Panna) of Madhya Pradesh. The region has diverse aquatic resources, including rivers, reservoirs, large tanks, community/village ponds and private ponds. Four major rivers, namely Yamuna, Betwa, Ken, Dhasan and several other rivers (Paisuni, Ganara, Pahuj, Sonar, Bina and Jamni) flow through the Bundelkhand region. Since the 1880s, several reservoirs and weirs have been constructed in the region to provide famine relief and ensure groundwater recharge. Though rich in diverse aquatic resources, the fisheries/aquaculture potential of the Bundelkhand region has not been optimally utilized. The fish farmers and rural population in the Bundelkhand belong to marginal section of the society with inadequate education, awareness and limited access to the latest scientific fish farming nowledge/technology. Thus, awareness generation through outreach programmes, transmission of the latest scientific knowledge and establishment of regular two-way feedback mechanisms are necessary to boost fish production and alleviate poverty. Besides, there is also a need to develop skilled human resources and entrepreneurship opportunities to further boost the growth of fisheries sector.
To cater to the needs of the fisheries sector, the College of Fisheries, Datia was established in the year 2023 under RLBCAU, Jhansi. Within a brief span, the college has carved a niche for itself in teaching, technical support, training, and capacity building for the development of fish farming and entrepreneurship in the region. The college aims to establish itself as a leading institution of knowledge dissemination. The College of Fisheries also intendsto utilize the linkages and feedback to further undertake teaching, research, and extension activities with National perspectives.
